attributes.title: 2027 NCPA Annual Convention
attributes.summary:
The 2027 NCPA Annual Convention is scheduled for September 25 to 28, 2027, in San Antonio, Texas. It is the national meeting of independent community pharmacy, mixing business and clinical education, pre-convention workshops, a large expo, a poster symposium and a residency showcase.

NCPA is an ACPE-accredited provider. For the 2026 convention it offered up to 12 contact hours of continuing pharmacy education for community pharmacists and technicians. The venue, CE hours and fees for 2027 have not been published yet. Later conventions are planned for Louisville (2028) and San Diego (2029).
